_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Religious Education 2046 Syllabus, Grade 10-12' (2013, published by CDC) — Grade 12, Units 1-10 (Topics 12.1-12.10), Part Two: Themes on Christian Witness and Behaviour. Cross-referenced against a parallel provincial Religious Education teaching-notes booklet covering the same unit structure, prepared for provincial use with no usage restriction; per standing instruction, no individual name is cited from either source, credit given only to CDC / Ministry of Education. Topic, sub-topic and Specific Outcome statements only; the 'Content' column (Bible passage references, knowledge points, skills, values) is omitted for the reasons documented in the Grade 10 file. As with Grade 10 and 11, this document's printed outcome numbering codes are unreliable throughout, so every sub-topic and outcome below was reconstructed by position — matching each outcome to the sub-topic heading it appears directly under in the source table, in the table's own reading order. A small number of outcomes in Units 2, 9 and 10 have no distinct sub-topic heading printed in the source table (the outcome follows directly after the previous sub-topic's outcomes with no new heading); these are marked 'implicit subtopic' and were grouped by their evident theme rather than invented. The syllabus organizes content by Grade only, not by Term in this file (a suggested termly Scheme of Work exists in the syllabus introduction assigning Units to terms), so all of Grade 12 is modeled as a single term here.
